description: COMMENT_CHAR_CAP moves from 60 to 80 (user decision 2026-10-05). `, so ` counts as a WHY marker. The what_comment action names the accepted markers. deferred_work_comment defaults to observe (user decision 2026-10-05), but a TODO line still answers to long_comment and prose_comment_block, so it cannot carry multi-line slop.
title: WHY detection, 80-character comment cap, TODO as warning
